caption:
ShipReX, the band from @rex_software and @urbanx.io, added Mustang Sally to their Sydney 2026 set at the last minute, with Battle of the Tech Bands founder Scott Warren on vocals. "We've only rehearsed it once, but we're gonna give it a go," he told the Manning Bar before the count-in. One rehearsal, and they nailed it. Also keep an eye out for MC and co-organiser Scott Bimrose, who came dressed for the part 😉

Video shot by @sailornicole and @demonrace, with photos and video sponsored by V2 AI.

Proudly powered by Jumbo Interactive. All proceeds to @youngcareoz, supporting young Australians with high care needs to live with more choice, freedom and dignity.
